# Complete a marked rectangular perimeter

In this Continual-ARC family, sparse same-color cells lie along the perimeter of an implied axis-aligned rectangle. Complete missing perimeter positions in a second color while retaining the original markers and all background/interior cells.

## Evidence and procedure
1. Identify background, perimeter-marker color, and rectangle bounds from the marker rows and columns.
2. Infer intended bounds from corner anchors and edge structure; do not assume marker extrema if demos show otherwise.
3. Examine the four perimeter segments: top and bottom rows across the bounds, plus left and right columns between them. Fill missing background cells on those segments with color 2 (observed here); preserve original markers. Do not fill the interior or extend beyond the perimeter.
4. Validate against all demos, especially corner placement and partially drawn edges. Keep dimensions and unrelated cells unchanged. Before submitting, scan every coordinate along all four inferred edges for gaps (including gaps on either vertical side); sparse markers can leave isolated missing perimeter cells that are easy to overlook.
